findings.title: Lab IAC has no drift detection or locked toolchain
evidence: infra/lab/terraform/versions.tf and infra/lab/ansible/requirements.yml use open ranges
no workflow runs `terraform plan`/`ansible --check`; `.terraform.lock.hcl` is not tracked
findings.impact: The declared lab (VMs, overlay, runner) and the running lab can drift with no automated detection.
findings.recommendation: Commit the lock file and add a scheduled read-only plan/check job against the lab.

findings.title: Example inventory is the only committed inventory
evidence: no environment-specific inventory or documented variable source for host addresses
findings.impact: Rebuilding the lab depends on uncommitted local values; drift is likely between rebuilds.
findings.recommendation: Document the variable source (env/secret) and validate the example against the Terraform outputs.

report: Reviewed infra/lab (Terraform + Ansible + runner bootstrap) and docs/LAB_IAC.md. No live apply was performed; state is not in the repo.
